items.title: Apothecary Brush Drying Rack — hangs brushes bristles-down
items.summary: A rack that dries makeup brushes the way every brush-care guide says to dry them: hanging HEAD DOWN over a drip tray. A brush stood bristles-up runs water into the ferrule, the glue softens and the brush sheds — this is the one makeup problem with a real failure mode behind it, and nothing prints a rack that fixes it. The grip is a WEDGE SLOT, not a hole: handles run about 6–12 mm and no single bore fits them, so each of the six slots tapers 13 → 5 mm over 22 mm and every brush catches at its own diameter, at about 9.4° per side, well inside PLA's friction angle. 172 mm of measured hang clears a 190 mm brush. The rail lifts straight off the two posts to load, and the tray is then a plain open dish you tip and rinse. 2 parts, 176 × 78 × 219 mm, 301 g, no supports, no hardware, no glue.

items.title: Cauldron Makeup Organizer — a bowl with no corners, no supports
items.summary: A three-legged cauldron that sorts makeup, and the bowl is the whole idea: it is a truncated sphere, so there is no corner anywhere inside it for powder to pack into. A 2.6 mm wall runs into a 3 mm floor through a 4 mm fillet rather than a crease, and one wipe reaches every part of the inside. Brushes stand in it bristles-up and fan out against the curve; a 4-way cross drops in to quarter the bowl for jars, sponges, compacts and hair ties, and lifts out to leave a plain brush cup. The three legs are a separate trivet ring the bowl drops into on a 45 degree cone, because legs cast under the bowl print as a horizontal overhang between them. 3 parts, 92 x 90 x 77 mm assembled, 117 g, no supports, no hardware, no glue — assembly is dropping one part into another.

items.title: Dragon Wing Palette Rack — eyeshadow palettes on edge, no supports
items.summary: An eyeshadow-palette rack whose fins are the finger bones of a dragon wing. Palettes stand on edge like books, so you read the spines and pull one out one-handed instead of excavating a stack. Five 16.5 mm slots take anything up to an 18 mm palette, with 100 mm of clear depth between the front rail and the back spine and a 76 mm shortest fin. Every segment of the fin profile is upward-facing, so a 112 mm tall part prints with ZERO supports. 1 part, 118 x 128 x 112 mm, no supports, no hardware, no assembly.

items.title: Drain Hair Snake — Barbed Clog Remover
items.summary: Flat flexible barbed drain stick that rakes hair clogs out of a shower, bath, or sink drain. Push the tip down the drain, twist, and pull — backward-pointing harpoon barbs grab the hair and drag it back out. One-piece print, no supports, no assembly. Finger-loop handle doubles as a hang hook and a stop so it cannot vanish down the drain.

items.title: Frost Crystal Casket — makeup organizer, no supports
items.summary: A block of glacier ice with a quartz cluster growing out of the back, and the cluster is the working part: all seven crystals are bored straight through, so a brush pushed into a shard stands bristles-up while its handle hangs in the box below — which is why a 120 mm and a 220 mm brush end up standing at the same height. Bores are cut to measured stock: Ø27 for mascara, two Ø23 that neck down to Ø14 so a lipstick rests on the shoulder, and four brush bores at Ø16 and Ø11. There is not one blind hole in the model and the well underneath is a single cavity with a 4 mm cove where the floor meets the wall, so nothing has a square corner to pack powder into. 3 parts, 132 × 114 × 100 mm, 298 g, no supports, no hardware, no glue.

items.title: Great Helm Makeup Organizer — knight's helm, no supports
items.summary: A 13th-century flat-topped great helm that is a makeup organizer on the inside. The crown is open and a lift-out liner drops onto the rim carrying the whole bore field, so brushes stand out of the helm like a crest: six brush bores go straight THROUGH so the handle hangs in the cavity and a 120 mm and a 220 mm brush stand at the same height, three tube bores (Ø27 mascara, two Ø23 lipstick) neck down instead of bottoming out, and an 88 × 24 mm palette slot rests a compact on an open 8 mm ledge. Not one bore is blind, so powder falls through into a smooth drum you tip out and rinse. 2 parts, 134 × 125 × 150 mm, 307 g, no supports, no hardware, no glue.

items.title: Medieval Well Makeup Organizer — no supports
items.summary: A stone draw-well with a winding gantry, a gable roof and a bucket on a string — and a makeup organizer inside it. The coping stone is a lift-off plate carrying all 11 bores, and not one of them is blind: a brush handle hangs free down the shaft, a mascara rests in a 45° seat cone instead of bottoming out, and loose powder falls straight past into a rinse dish in the plinth. Cleaning is lift, lift, tip, rinse. 5 parts, Ø144 × 176 mm, 420 g, no supports, no hardware, no glue — just ~120 mm of twine for the bucket.

items.title: Moonwake Makeup Wardrobe — a 240 mm two-door cabinet with printed hinges and lift-off door bins
items.summary: A 240 x 200 x 228 mm cabinet for makeup and hygiene: two engraved doors on four printed pins that swing to 160 degrees, four lift-off bins on the door panels, and two removable organizers inside for brushes, tubes and palettes. 13 parts, no hardware, no glue, no supports.

items.title: Q-tip Cup — Fluted Cylinder with Snap-Fit Lid
items.summary: Ø69 × 60 mm fluted cup that holds ~250 standard cotton swabs, with a faceted gem-top lid that snaps on with an audible click. Doric-style vertical flutes (24 concave grooves) on the cup, octagonal gem dome on the lid. Two STLs, prints flat, no supports.

items.title: Shower Hair Catcher — Drop-In Cup Strainer
items.summary: Drop-in cup-style shower / bath / sink drain hair catcher. Open-top cup, fine hex bottom strainer, twelve internal posts that snag drifting fibres. One piece, no hardware, no supports. Parametric — retune for any drain Ø.

items.title: Soap Dish — Wooden-Slat Cradle, Parametric Wood-Grain
items.summary: Single-piece slatted soap dish that cradles oval and brick bars without rolling. Five saddle planks carry an oval bar; two flat fenders at each end keep larger blocks from migrating off. Drainage runs straight through the slat gaps onto the counter (or into a tray). Parametric wood-grain grooves on the slat sides — prints best in wood-fiber PLA for a real wooden look.

items.title: Tenshu Makeup Organizer — Japanese castle keep, 3 lift-off storeys
items.summary: A Japanese castle keep (tenshu) that sorts makeup. Every roof is the lid of the storey under it: the base holds four compacts on edge in a lift-out comb plus a polish bay, the second storey has three coved lanes for a mascara, lipsticks and pencils lying down, the third a tweezer lane and two cells for lashes, pins and rings. Every pocket is a hull of four spheres, so the floor meets the wall on a 4 mm cove and nothing is a square corner or a blind hole: lift, lift, lift, tip, rinse. Five parts, no supports, no glue, no hardware — each lid seats on a 2.4 mm ring so the stack does not rock, and magnets are an option, not a need. Ships as one-colour STLs and, for a multi-filament printer, as one three-colour STL per part that Split to Parts divides into exactly three: cream plaster, dark timber, slate stone-and-tile. A five-colour split-to-parts STL per part ships too, if you have the slots for a separate plinth grey and gold shachihoko.

items.title: Toothbrush Travel Case — Print-in-Place Hinged Box with Snap Latch
items.summary: 200 × 25 × 25 mm hinged toothbrush travel case. Single print-in-place — body, lid, hinge, and front snap latch all come off the bed as one assembled piece. Fold the lid 90° forward; thumb tab clicks into the catch.

items.title: Toothpaste Tube Squeezer — Roller Key, Diamond-Knurl Grip
items.summary: Single-piece roller key for toothpaste / cosmetic tubes. Slot the empty end of the tube through the slit, fold once, twist the body — the tube wraps around the bar and you crank every last gram out. Hang hole at top. Diamond-knurl engraving on both faces for grip.

items.title: Wizard Tower Makeup Organizer — 4 lift-apart tiers
items.summary: A wizard's tower that sorts makeup. Brushes hang bristles-up from five wedge bores through the roof cone, so each one catches at its own handle diameter and a 120 mm and a 190 mm brush stand at the same height. The balcony deck takes a mascara, two lipsticks and three pencils; the plinth is a deep open bin for polish and jars. Every one of the eleven openings is a THROUGH hole and the bin floor is coved into the wall, so powder falls through instead of packing into a blind corner: the tower lifts apart into four pieces you tip and rinse under a tap. No supports, no glue, no hardware — every joint is a triangular tongue that drops into a V-groove.

items.title: Marsh — Backlit Modular LED Swamp Terrain Runner (28-32mm, chainable)
items.summary: A backlit modular swamp runner for 28-32mm tabletop games. A winding translucent creek glows from below when a 30cm USB LED strip slides into a hidden channel. Two printed parts per segment (one is a two-colour terrain plate), no supports, no glue. Identical segments dovetail end-to-end so one strip threads straight through the whole run; the river, banks and bog texture flow continuously across every joint. Confirmed printed and lit.

items.title: Breach Dungeon Tiles — modular D&D base squares + drop-in terrain
items.summary: A modular dungeon-building kit of snap-together base square tiles plus everything that drops into them: floor-texture inserts (stone, cracked ground, cobbles, rubble, fissures), wall pieces, and scatter props (chests, barrels, statues, trees, crystals). Every insert, wall and prop sits on the same 27.9 mm square base. Prints support-free. Pairs with any 28 mm minis.

items.title: Cascadia Market Rack + 3D Wildlife Tokens
items.summary: A two-in-one Cascadia upgrade: a market-row display rack that holds the four face-up habitat tile + wildlife token pairs on a gentle 15° slope, PLUS a full set of five sculpted 3D wildlife tokens (bear, elk, salmon, hawk, fox) that replace the flat wooden discs and drop straight into the rack's Ø19 cups. The rack prints flat and supportless in one part; each animal prints upright on a Ø18 base disc in its own colour — no AMS, no paint. Parametric OpenSCAD source included.

items.title: Travel Cribbage Peg Track — Captive Slide-In Pegs, 1 to 6 Players
items.summary: A pocket cribbage scorer with captive scoring pegs that can never fall out. Each player's peg rides a hidden T-channel and clicks into every score station on a self-centring ball-detent, so it always lands exactly on the number. Slide the pegs into the open end, snap the end cap on, and they are enclosed for good. One parametric design, bundled in every player count from 1 to 6.

items.title: Adventurer Dial Base — a mini base that counts your damage 0–9
items.summary: A Ø36 mm miniature base with a rotating 0–9 counter ring built into it. It prints in place: the disc and the ring come off the plate already interlocked, no assembly, no hardware. A hooded wanderer figure is included — drop it in, or print the version with it welded on.

items.title: D&D Death Save Tracker — slide up for a heart, down for a skull
items.summary: A flat, silent death-saving-throw tracker for D&D 5e. Three captive sliders: push one UP and a red heart fills the top window (success), push it DOWN and a white skull fills the bottom one (failure), leave it centred and both stay blank. Three hearts you're stable, three skulls you're dead — the whole table can read your state from across it. Five printed parts, no glue, no screws, no dice-sized bits to lose; everything prints flat and supportless. Parametric OpenSCAD source included.

items.title: Cassandra Rift Overlay Hex Tokens — Frosthaven / Gloomhaven (3-colour, a mini stands on it)
items.summary: 3D rift overlay hex tokens for Cassandra the Forgotten Diviner (Frosthaven / Gloomhaven). Each is a 38.1 mm flat-top map hex with a recessed flat central plaza a mini can stand on, ringed by a raised ornate runic frame. Three-colour AMS print: dark stone body, a magenta energy vortex flush in the plaza floor, and gold raised runes on the frame. Prints support-free — every feature steps up. Includes a fit-test coupon and the parametric OpenSCAD source.

items.title: Ghost Falcon Summon Standee with Life Dial — Frosthaven
items.summary: A 37.5 mm hex standee for Cassandra's Ghost Falcon summon. The captive ring turns to show 1–4 life; the pedestal shows 2 damage, 4 health and 3 movement. One print, no assembly.

items.title: Frosthaven Lurker Deepwraith Kill Counter
items.summary: Snap-together rotating dial that tracks kills through a window under a skull. Sized for the Lurker (Deepwraith) Frosthaven personal quest. Also ships a 0-9 variant for any game that wants a tiny mechanical counter.

items.title: Baby Dragons' Secret Picnic — a cooperative board game for children aged 3-8
items.summary: A cooperative hidden-berry game for children from three years old. Nobody owns a dragon, nobody loses on their own, and nothing has to be remembered — every berry turned over stays face up. 1-6 players, 15-25 minutes, prints on an existing PlayGrid board.

items.title: Blank Dice — d6/d8/d12/d20 with recessed label panels
items.summary: Blank d6, d8, d12 and d20 whose every face carries a recessed, chamfered panel, so a sticker or a dry-erase mark sits below the surface with no edge to catch. Numbered versions included, single-colour or two-colour from one file, plus 1:1 sticker sheets cut to the panel.

items.title: Catan Replacement Set — Settlements, Cities, Roads, Knights, Ships & More
items.summary: Hand-sculpted replacement set for Catan + Cities & Knights + Seafarers + Traders & Barbarians. 15 pieces: textured cobblestone road (thin/half/full), gabled cottage settlement, cityhall + crenellated brick wall ring, hooded robber, three escalating C&K knights (basic/strong/mighty), C&K barbarian + merchant, Seafarers galleon ship + tricorne pirate, T&B recumbent caravan camel. All silhouettes designed to print supportless on FDM.

items.title: Catan Cities & Knights Event Die — Engraved Replacement
items.summary: Cities & Knights event die (16 mm rounded d6) with 6 engraved silhouettes: 3× viking ship (barbarian advance) + 1× round tower (yellow/trade) + 1× square keep (green/science) + 1× cathedral spire (blue/politics). Paint-fill the 0.8 mm recesses or print the included inlay plugs in 4 contrast filaments for an AMS multicolour result.

items.title: Crit Dice — d6 / d12 / d20 whose top face is a sword, bow or staff
items.summary: Nine dice: three solids x three glyphs. Every ordinary face is a plain numeral you read at a glance; only the crit face is a picture, so a natural 20 lands as a drawn sword instead of a number. Fair on all nine (opposite faces sum to 7 / 13 / 21). Single-colour, or two-colour from one file on an AMS.

items.title: Crooked Dice — a fair die, a gaff die and a loaded die that look identical
items.summary: Three 16 mm d6 from one source: an honest die, a duplicate-face gaff showing only 5 and 6, and a die with a sealed void under the 6. Same body, same size, same weight to within a tenth of a gram. Ships the float-test cup that catches the loaded one, and states how crooked each die is as a measured number instead of an adjective — centre-of-mass offset and tipping-barrier ratio for all six faces. A magic and party prop, sold with its own counter-measure.

items.title: Custom d12 — a fair gaming die and a spindown counter, 18 mm
items.summary: One 18 mm twelve-sided die in two numberings: a fair gaming d12 whose opposite faces sum to 13, and a spindown counter where every consecutive pair of numbers shares an edge so one roll of the die is one step. Prints flat on a pentagon with no supports. Single-colour for paint-fill, or two-colour on an AMS.

items.title: Custom d20 — Fair Die & Spindown Counter, 2-Colour Inlay Numbers
items.summary: A parametric d20 in two numbering layouts: a FAIR gaming die (opposite faces sum to 21, apex-up digits) and a SPINDOWN life/turn counter (consecutive numbers on adjacent faces). Two-colour recessed digit inlay — print the body in one colour and the number plugs in another. Arabic / roman / letter symbols, fully editable .scad. Prints flat with a brim, no supports.

items.title: Round-Brilliant Diamond Token — Board Game Gem (Parametric)
items.summary: A faceted round-brilliant diamond as a tabletop game gem / resource token: scalloped girdle, straight crown flare to a flat table, and a stepped pavilion. Prints table-down with the culet pointing up, so it needs no supports. Parametric OpenSCAD source included — change the girdle diameter, facet count, and proportions to taste. Single gem plus a 4-up plate.

items.title: Domino Box — Sleeve + Tray for the Double-Six 28-Tile Set (OpenSCAD)
items.summary: Two-piece storage for a full 28-tile double-six domino set. Outer sleeve (closed on 5 faces, open on one short end) + inner tray with a Ø28 mm semicircular thumb-notch on its front wall. Tiles lie flat in a 4×2 grid of 4-tile stacks (32-slot capacity). Sleeve prints with the open mouth UP — fully supportless. Engraved decorative pip pattern on every long face. Parametric SCAD lets you re-tune tile dimensions, slop, layout (piles_x × piles_y), pip pattern, or wall thicknesses.

items.title: Domino Set — Double-Six (28 tiles), 2-Colour Engraved (OpenSCAD)
items.summary: Full double-six domino set: 28 tiles, 36 × 18 × 5.5 mm each, Ø2.4 mm engraved pips + centre line. Two-colour print via Bambu AMS — combined named-solid STL (Split-to-Parts) ships alongside separate body + pips STLs for non-Bambu printers. Parametric SCAD included so you can re-tune tile size, pip diameter, or face content (single-tile mode `left`/`right` lets you reprint any face).

items.title: Dragon's Nap — a co-op heist board game round a sleeping dragon, all printed
items.summary: A co-op heist for 1-4. Lift gems from under a sleeping dragon whose head really turns, and get out before it wakes.

items.title: Ticking Turn Timer — wind-up escapement, no electronics, no metal parts
items.summary: A real mechanical escapement you can print: wind the knob, let go, and a foliot bar rocks tick-tick-tick while an arrow creeps back over the dial — silence means the turn is over. All 7 parts print flat and supportless; the only non-printed items are two coins used as tuning weights. NOTE: this is a mechanism demonstrator / desk toy, NOT an accurate timer — see the description.

items.title: Go-first dice — four d12 that settle the whole turn order in one fair roll
items.summary: Four twelve-sided dice carrying the numbers 1-48, one each. Everyone rolls once and reads the turn order straight off the table. Ties are impossible, and every one of the 24 finishing orders is exactly equally likely, so it does not matter which die a player picks up. Works for 2 and 3 players too by leaving dice in the bag. The numbering is a solved combinatorial object and the build refuses to export unless a brute-force check over all 20736 rolls still passes.

items.title: Goblin Night Market — a print-and-play board game for PlayGrid
items.summary: A fast Monopoly run by goblins. Roll, move round the loop, buy the stall you land on, pay whoever got there first — half an hour, no debt, no auctions, nobody knocked out. 2-4 players, everything printable.

items.title: Harbour Light — pocket board game in a box that is the board
Meeple & Standee Stand Base — Friction Slot Holder for Thin Tokens (Parametric, OpenSCAD)
items.summary: A weighted clip base that holds any THIN game token upright — cardboard punchboard standees, acrylic or printed silhouettes, even a card edge. The token drops into a friction slot with a flared insertion mouth; the wide footprint resists tipping in the easy-to-tip direction (across the slot). Optional vertical grip ribs pinch flimsy card so it can't flop. One slider — slot_w — tunes the slot to YOUR token thickness (~1.6 acrylic / 2.2 standard cardboard / ~7 a printed meeple slab). Prints flat, slot UP, zero supports. Single base or a batch plate.

items.title: Meeple Set — Humans & Animals
items.summary: A big set of classic wooden-style meeples: six human figures (plain worker, warrior, king, wizard, archer, axeman) in several sizes, plus eight animal pawns (cat, rabbit, dog, mouse, sheep, goat, duck, horse). Chunky flat tokens that print flat with zero supports — drop-in replacements and extras for almost any board game.

items.title: Mimic Vault — dice drawer in a monster that eats the loot
items.summary: A ruined stone monument that's secretly a mimic: the front drawer is its maw and slides out to reveal your 7-die set, relief teeth grin under a translucent crystal bait pile on top. Prints upright, no supports. Includes a matching two-colour D6 with bone-femur Roman numerals.

items.title: Custom Stroke Dice — a d20 + d6 you read by counting strokes
items.summary: A d20 and a d6 numbered in a custom stroke script instead of digits: strokes cut across a centre line, and where they sit plus how many there are gives the value. Nothing to memorise — count the strokes, read their angle. Prints single-colour (crisp recesses, ready for paint-fill) or two-colour on an AMS.

items.title: The Older Current — a board game for PlayGrid
items.summary: A complete 2-4 player strategy game on the PlayGrid grid — board, 100 tiles, 12 figures and a box, all included. You never move your own people; you re-aim the current that carries them.

items.title: Pasa — Indian long dice, the d4 you can actually roll
items.summary: A long die: a square rod marked on its four long sides and capped at both ends so it can never stand up. You roll it like a pencil and read the number on top. Ships the traditional Chaupar/Pachisi stave (faces 1-2-5-6) and a plain 1-2-3-4 version, each in one colour and as a two-colour Split-to-Parts file. 62 x 10 x 10 mm, flat on the bed, no supports. The opposite-face pairing is chosen to MINIMISE bias, not to sum to seven — 4.1x less centre-of-mass offset, and the two-colour build cancels it entirely.

items.title: Pumpkin d6 — Every Pip Is a Pumpkin, the 1 Is a Jack-o'-Lantern
items.summary: A standard 20 mm six-sided die where all 21 pips are little pumpkins and the lone 1 is a carved jack-o'-lantern. Prints in two colours from a single STL — import, Split to Parts, done. No supports, no brim.

items.title: Emoji Reaction Die — a mood d6 that replaces the RPG reaction roll
items.summary: One 18 mm d6 with six emoji faces on a HOSTILE → HELPFUL ladder. Roll it when the party meets an NPC and read the attitude straight off the top face — no 2d6 lookup table, no maths. Opposite faces hold opposite attitudes. Three interchangeable face styles in the box (geometric, emoji-glyph, cartoon) and every style ships as a two-colour combined STL with the faces as flush inlays, plus a single-colour version with paint-fillable recesses. Prints on any face, no supports.

items.title: Parametric Rounded D6 — Numbers / Roman / Letters (OpenSCAD)
items.summary: Six-sided die with softly-rounded edges. Three ready-to-print STL variants (Arabic 1-6, Roman I-VI, Letters A-F) plus the OpenSCAD source for any custom face-set (unicode, up to 3 chars per face).

items.title: Rune Die — a d6 numbered in real runic numerals
items.summary: A 16 mm d6 whose faces carry the six runes the Norse actually used as the numbers 1 to 6 — genuine numerals from the runic calendar, not letters standing in for digits. Prints single-colour for paint-fill, or two-colour on an AMS from one file.

items.title: Spell-Slot Abacus — print-in-place D&D spell-slot tracker
items.summary: A print-in-place abacus for tracking D&D spell slots: 9 rails (spell levels 1–9) of captive sliding crystal beads (4/3/3/3/3/2/2/1/1 = full-caster max). Slide a bead to burn a slot, sweep back on a long rest. A tilt-lock detent at mid-span keeps the count from scrambling when you pick the board up. ~107 × 130 × 8 mm, zero supports.

items.title: Teetotum Set — Spinning-Top Dice (d6 · d8 · d10 · d12, 2-Colour)
items.summary: The pre-dice gambling top, four ways: spin it, let it topple, read the up-facing number. d6/d8/d10/d12, each a 2-colour print with a modelled break-away support that peels off clean — no scars, no slicer supports.

items.title: Tengwar d6 — a 20 mm die numbered in elvish duodecimal numerals
items.summary: A 20 mm six-sided die whose pips are replaced by authentic Tengwar duodecimal numerals. Opposite faces sum to 7 and the 1-2-3 corner is the standard right-handed arrangement, so it rolls like any ordinary d6 — it just reads elvish. Print it single colour and paint-fill the recesses, or drop in the coordinate-locked numeral plugs for a two-colour AMS print. Printed and verified.

items.title: The Answering — a co-operative board game for PlayGrid
items.summary: A complete 1-4 player co-op game on the PlayGrid grid — 28 figures, 17 tiles, a die and its tower, all included. The swarm never takes a turn of its own. It answers yours.

items.title: The Everfruit Vale — a competitive and cooperative board game for PlayGrid
items.summary: A tile-laying game with two modes in one box. Draft from four face-up tiles, place two a turn, and plant Grovekeepers in the root networks you want to score. Competitive for 2-4 or cooperative for 1-4, 35-50 minutes, on an existing PlayGrid 10x10 board.

items.title: Potion-Vial Dice — Rolling d10 / d100 + Apothecary Display Stand (OpenSCAD)
items.summary: Rolling-log d10 dice shaped like alchemist's potion vials — faceted glass body, tapered neck and cork. Roll one like a log and it always settles on a flat face; a units vial (1–10) plus a tens vial (00–90) roll percentile d100. Three-colour AMS (potion + numerals + cork) via Split-to-Parts, or single-colour with paint-fill grooves. Ships with a 6-bay arched apothecary display stand engraved with the classical-element sigils. Face labels are fully parametric. NOTE: the stand is a decorative display — vials rest loosely in open sockets, it is not a carry case.

items.title: Watchfires — a stacking board game of beacons for 2–4, all printed
items.summary: A stacking game of beacons for 2-4. Every ring you place is a watchman who counts the towers he can see.

items.title: MTG — Amass Army Dial (0–15, goblin knob)
items.summary: A two-part rotating counter for a single growing Army token. Only ONE number is ever visible, through a window in the fixed cap, so it reads like a tally slate rather than a clock face. Thumb on the goblin holds the cap, fingers turn the scalloped rim, every number lands with a detent click. Two printed parts, no glue, no hardware, no supports.

items.title: MTG — Mana Barrel Counter (3-Drum Hex Dial)
items.summary: Three-digit (0-999) rotating barrel counter for Magic: the Gathering — hex prism with three independently-rotating drums, capped at each end by a hex cap engraved with the chosen mana symbol (W/U/B/R/G or colourless). Caps lock to a shared square axle so the drums rotate but the caps don't. Engraved digits + mana symbols print as 2-AMS Bambu Split-to-Parts. ~50 mm tall, no supports, PLA.

items.title: MTG Deck Box with Mana Symbol Lid
items.summary: Simple cap-lid deck box for sleeved Commander-sized MTG decks. Lid has an embossed mana symbol (WUBRG); optional second-color inlay STL for two-colour AMS printing.

items.title: MTG City's Blessing — Ornate Citadel Emblem
items.summary: Highly detailed citadel emblem for Magic: The Gathering's City's Blessing Ascend mechanic. Print in metallic gold (the original was Bambu metallic PLA) and seat on any small disc base to track when you have 10+ permanents.

items.title: MTG — Creature Token Tracker (P/T Wheels + Type & Ability Tiles)
items.summary: A card-side dashboard for tracking a single Magic: the Gathering creature token. Two flat 0–9 spin-wheels show Power / Toughness; a row of side-loading tiles behind them name the creature's TYPE and its keyword ABILITIES. Includes the token chassis + snap-on lid + two-colour digit wheel, a storage box with engraved mana-symbol lid, and the full set of 47 creature-type tiles and 42 keyword-ability tiles. Engravings print as 2-AMS Bambu Split-to-Parts, or single-colour. No supports; print the token chassis + lid in PETG (the snap pins), everything else in PLA.

items.title: MTG — Day / Night Flip Token (60mm Disc)
items.summary: 60 mm two-sided flip token for the Day/Night mechanic in Magic: the Gathering. Sun (with 12 radiating rays) on the day face; crescent moon + 3 stars on the night face. Flip the token whenever a card transitions Day↔Night so the current state is always visible. Two-colour AMS print: dark body + gold engravings.

items.title: MTG — Food · Blood · Clue Artifact Token Set
items.summary: A set of three 3D artifact tokens for Magic: the Gathering, replacing the cardboard punch-outs: FOOD as a realistic lattice pie, BLOOD as a faceted gem-cut drop, and CLUE as a detective's magnifying glass. Each token prints flat, supportless, in one colour (or paint the details). ~22–30 mm, PLA. Parametric OpenSCAD source included.

items.title: MTG Mana Buttons — all six mana symbols as real sewing buttons, 15 / 20 / 25 mm, hidden shank or 2-hole
items.summary: Wearable sewing buttons carrying all six Magic mana symbols — white sun, blue drop, black skull, red fireball, green tree and the colorless lozenge. 30 STLs: 6 symbols x 5 size/style combos. The 'tunnel' style hides a thread shank in the underside so the face stays whole and nothing is bored through the emblem; the 'holed' style is a classic 2-hole shirt button with both bores in the plain ring. Ø15 / 20 / 25 mm (24L / 32L / 40L). Every button ships a named-solid 2-colour companion for AMS. Prints flat, face up, no supports, no brim, no hardware. Fully parametric OpenSCAD — any diameter, and the glyph strokes are held at or above one nozzle width automatically.

items.title: MTG Mana Counter Set — 6 colors, twin-dial
items.summary: Snap-together MTG mana / life counters, one per colour (W U B R G C). Twin dials behind a window track 0-99 with a thumb-twist on the exposed dial rim. Two-colour AMS print, no fasteners.

items.title: Mana Press — screw press for Magic cards: flatten a bowed deck, brick a freshly sleeved one
items.summary: A printed screw press for Magic cards. Two threaded posts, a yoke and two thumb nuts squeeze a stack flat overnight, or squeeze a freshly sleeved deck back into a brick that drops into its box. The posts ARE the screws — there is no hardware anywhere in the model, no screws, magnets or inserts. Height is set by stacking 12 mm pressure plates, which double as the WUBRG mana rainbow and each ship a named-solid 2-colour companion for AMS. An optional, experimental arc pair over-bends a curled foil past its set. 11 STLs, 6 printed parts, no supports, fully parametric OpenSCAD.

items.title: MTG — Map Token Counter (1-10 Compass Dial)
items.summary: Physical MTG Map artifact token that doubles as a 1-10 counter, styled as a pocket compass. 56 mm two-colour face with numerals, tick ring and engraved compass rose. The two-tone needle presses over the centre post ONCE and clicks captive — then spins freely forever. Bambu AMS-friendly (split-to-parts named solids).

items.title: Marit Lage 20/20 Token — MTG flat-card display plinth with eldritch sculpt + multicolour text
items.summary: A display plinth for the Marit Lage token from Magic: The Gathering (Dark Depths) — laid out like a Magic card lying flat (≈90 × 60 mm, low 4 mm base). A colossal Lovecraftian tentacle sculpt sits as the 'art', RAISED multicolour text reads MARIT LAGE on top, INDESTRUCTIBLE / FLYING in front of the art, and a big 20/20 power/toughness on the front vertical wall. Prints flat, plinth-on-bed, creature up — supportless. Ships as ONE combined STL with named solids for Bambu 'Split to Parts': one per BLOCK (combined) or one per CHARACTER (chars) for clean per-letter AMS colouring with zero accent bleed.

items.title: Monarch Crown Token (MTG) — 3-Colour Heraldic Crown, OpenSCAD
items.summary: Heraldic crown token for the Monarch mechanic in Magic: The Gathering. Slow-cylinder bell band + 7 tall triangular spikes alternating with 7 short crenel spikes, Ø5 mm orb finials on each tall tip. "MONARCH" wraps around the band as inset 2-colour text. 3-colour print via Bambu AMS — combined named-solid STL (Split-to-Parts) ships alongside per-filament STLs.

items.title: MTG — Pact Reminder Token (YOU WILL PAY Scroll)
items.summary: Medieval-scroll reminder token for Magic: the Gathering. Drop in front of an opponent who owes you a Pact upkeep (Pact of Negation, Slaughter Pact, Intervention Pact, Pact of the Titans, Summoner's Pact) or anyone trying to skip a delayed cost. 55×80 mm slim slab with raised parchment-roll ridges top + bottom and 'YOU WILL PAY' in raised medieval lettering. Two-colour AMS print: parchment body + ink letters.

items.title: MTG — +1/+1 Counter Die (d6, +N/+N Faces)
items.summary: A 16 mm six-sided creature counter die for Magic: the Gathering. Each face engraved with +N / +N (power / toughness) — values 1 through 6, opposite faces sum to 7. Two-colour Bambu AMS print: dark body + bright '+N' digits via Split-to-Parts.

items.title: MTG Powerstone Token — Flip-to-Tap Crystal
items.summary: Chunky 60 × 30 × 16 mm faceted crystal token for Magic: the Gathering's Powerstone artifacts. It rests flat on either octagonal face: plain side up is untapped, tap-arrow side up is tapped. Flip it instead of rotating it. Prints as one part with no supports.

items.title: MTG — The Ring Tempts You Tracker (Barad-dûr Plaque)
items.summary: Two-piece tracker for the LotR Ring mechanic. Tower-of-Sauron silhouette plaque with 4 detent pockets (Levels I–IV) + ability label inset beside each in a second filament colour, plus a small One-Ring marker that the active player places in the current level. ~130 mm tall, prints flat, no supports. Bambu AMS 2-colour: dark body + gold labels.

items.title: MTG — Saga Chapter Dial (I / II / III / IV) with Snap-Fit Pointer
items.summary: Ornate 4-chapter dial for tracking which chapter (I, II, III, IV) of a Saga enchantment you're on. Two-colour 55 mm disc with engraved laurel-wreath border + Roman numerals; separate pointer snap-fits onto the centre post and rotates freely. Bambu AMS-friendly (split-to-parts named solids).

items.title: MTG Treasure Token Chest — print-in-place pirate chest counter (1-6)
items.summary: A working pirate chest that IS your MTG Treasure counter: friction-fit gold coins stand edge-up in six slots and the number standing is the count (1-6). Real print-in-place barrel lid on a piano hinge — closes with all six coins seated. Coins print separately in gold. Includes a brand-neutral GEM coin too, so the same chest doubles as a loot/gold tracker for D&D and any dungeon-crawler.

items.title: MTG Undercity Dungeon — Hex pyramid prop
items.summary: Physical play prop for the MTG Undercity dungeon (Commander Legends: Baldur's Gate). 9 hex rooms with engraved effects, doors on the canonical 12 connections, peg-mounted player pins. Two-colour AMS-friendly.

items.title: Dahan — Spirit Island Tribal Hut Token (2-Colour, AMS Split-to-Parts)
items.summary: Spirit Island dahan tokens shaped like a Pacific-Islander tribal hut — woven body with low-relief door + tall conical thatched roof, Ø22 × 20 mm. Ships as a 2-named-solid combined STL (import → Split to Parts in Bambu Studio) for a 2-AMS-colour print (thatch tan + wall brown). Per-half binary STLs included for single-colour or mono-extruder users.

items.title: Spirit Island Energy Counter (0-20 Dial)
items.summary: Snap-together rotating dial that tracks per-player energy (0..20) through a window under the eight Spirit Island element glyphs. Two physical parts, four STLs, two filaments via Bambu AMS.

items.title: Spirit Island Tokens — Amateur Set (5 pieces, two-color)
items.summary: Five simple fan-made Spirit Island board-game tokens (Beast, Wilds, Mountain, Strife, Beasts/Paw) designed in OpenSCAD for Bambu Lab AMS two-color printing. Rough and beginner-quality — functional, not display-grade.

items.title: Terraforming Mars Track Figures — Biodome, Reactor, Rover
items.summary: Three sculpted markers for the Terraforming Mars tracks: a greenhouse biodome for oxygen, a fluted cooling tower for temperature and a six-wheel rover for generation. Each is one solid print on a Ø12 mm base, upright with no supports, no assembly and no hardware — about 2.2 g of PLA for the whole set. Print one filament per figure; they replace the game's ordinary markers on its existing printed tracks.

items.title: Wingspan Card Holder — 3 Slots, Bird Silhouettes
items.summary: 3-slot tilted-back card holder for Wingspan bird cards (or any 55×90 mm sleeved card). Each cell has a different bird silhouette (kiwi / sparrow / eagle) on its back wall — revealed when the card is removed.

items.title: Wingspan Dice Nest Tray — Twig-Clad Bird's Nest Dice Tray
items.summary: Dice tray for Wingspan (or any tabletop game) shaped like a woven bird's nest outside, rectangular cavity inside. 600 randomly-placed twig cylinders, no supports, no hardware.

items.title: Wingspan Twigs Nest — Stadium-Shaped Bird's Nest Dice Tray
items.summary: Shallow stadium-shaped dice tray for Wingspan (or any board game) shaped like a real woven bird's nest. ~1100 procedural perimeter twigs sweep continuously around the perimeter; ~800 short pillars in the saucer interior recreate a pebble/twig floor texture. No supports, no hardware.

items.title: Library of Alexandria box — a magnetic box under the great dome
items.summary: The Library of Alexandria as a box: a white-marble hall behind an arcade of pointed arches, a full-width stair, four turrets under gilded onion domes and a great ribbed dome on a chevroned drum. Everything above the cornice is the lid, and eight Ø5 × 3 mm magnets buried mid-print hold it shut. 118 × 96 × 113 mm outside, 90 × 60 × 45 mm inside. Six STLs, two prints, no supports, no glue.

items.title: Honeycomb Hinged Storage Box — Large (PIP, 3 sizes)
items.summary: Big rectangular storage box with hex pattern on every wall + print-in-place piano hinge — prints OPEN, snaps shut, no assembly. Three sizes bundled.

items.title: Coin Cell Battery Dispenser — multi-section tray (parametric OpenSCAD)
items.summary: Half-cylinder edge-mount wells for coin cells: pinch one out by the visible half. Six sections cover CR2032 / CR2025 / CR2016 / CR1620 / LR1130 / LR44 — 29 cells total. Parametric: edit the sections list to retarget any cell stash.

items.title: Capybara Lock Box — Magnetic Two-Key Drawer Box
items.summary: A drawer box that only opens when you set TWO capybara figurines on its lid pads. The capybaras are the keys — each hides a magnet that lifts a hidden loose-magnet shear pin off the drawer rail. Both keys at once = a two-capybara combination lock. Multi-color engraved lid, captive drawer, self-locking. Uses hobby disc magnets you drop in during printing. Keys included.

items.title: Carousel Drawer Tower — Stacking Swing-Out Parts Organiser
items.summary: A modular desk organiser of pie-wedge bins that swing out around a central post. Stack as many tiers as you like; a wide fillable ballast dish keeps it planted. Fully parametric OpenSCAD.

items.title: Castle keep box — a fortified keep that opens at the wall-walk
items.summary: A 112 mm square castle keep whose lid is the wall-walk: lift the battlements, four corner drums and their tiled conical roofs straight off and the keep is a 70 x 70 x 64 mm box. Two prints, no supports, no hardware, nothing to glue. The lid rests rather than latches, so it is a table box, not a travelling one. Multi-colour for the AMS, and it still reads as a castle in one filament.

items.title: Coffee Bean Box — Bean-Shaped Trinket Box (2 Parts, No Supports)
items.summary: A little lidded trinket box shaped like a coffee bean, crease and all. Two printed parts, friction-fit lip, no supports, no hardware. 82 × 50 × 21 mm closed.

items.title: Coffin Pencil Case — Magnetic Box with a Death's-Head Moth Lid
items.summary: A toe-pincher coffin box for pens, markers and brushes. The lid is held by six pairs of hidden magnets buried mid-print, so no fastener is visible anywhere. Prints flat, no supports, one colour or two.

items.title: Composition Book Lunchbox — a snack caddy shaped like a school notebook
items.summary: A 150 x 105 x 52 mm lunch/snack caddy that looks like a marbled composition notebook. Print-in-place-style pin hinge (the pin prints too), no hardware, no supports, no glue. Three parts, three colours, and the colour split costs about 1.4 g of purge for the whole set.

items.title: Parametric Apothecary Cabinet / Labelled Spice Rack
items.summary: Wall-mountable N×M grid of cubbies, each holding a drop-in drawer with a raised label. Includes ready-to-print 2×3 English spice rack (Salt, Pepper, Sugar, Cinnamon, Rosemary, Curry). Edit the OpenSCAD source to change grid, cubby size, frame style, or label text.

items.title: Decorative Honeycomb Box (Parametric)
items.summary: Open-top storage box with a hex pattern engraved on every wall — fully parametric OpenSCAD source.

items.title: Elven Motif Keepsake Box — vesica plan, interlaced vine walls, two-colour leaf inlay
items.summary: A pointed-oval trinket box where every ornament is the same shape at three scales: the box plan, the leaves woven into the wall braid, and the veined leaf inlaid in the lid. The wall vine is a genuine over-and-under interlace, not two sine waves. Two printed parts, no supports, no hardware, no glue — and the two-colour lid costs about 1 g of purge because all the ink sits in three layers.

items.title: Grimoire Box — a hinged spellbook with the magnets sealed inside
items.summary: A leather-bound tome that opens on a real barrel hinge. Two sizes, any word you like on the cover, and four magnets that end up fully enclosed in the plastic - nothing visible in any face. Three printed parts, no supports, no screws, no glue.

items.title: Haunted House Screw Organizer — 3 Drawer Floors, Crooked Mansard Roof
items.summary: A crooked Victorian mansard house whose three floors are pull-out drawers for screws, nuts and bits. Five parts, no hardware, no glue, no supports; the pumpkin face and glowing windows are a second colour on the drawer fronts.

items.title: Heart Trinket Box — Friction-Fit Lid (Two Fits)
items.summary: A little heart-shaped box with a plug-in friction-fit lid. Two lid versions included — a relaxed fit and a firmer one — so you can pick how tightly it holds. Fully parametric OpenSCAD source.

items.title: Lattice Basket — Parametric Desk Organiser
items.summary: A 15 × 10 × 5 cm open-lattice basket with 45° crosshatch walls, solid corner columns, and a flat rim. No supports needed.

items.title: Parametric Stackable Storage Box (1×1 to 5×5)
items.summary: Stackable storage drawers with stud-and-hole interlock — they tile sideways and stack vertically with each other. 25 ready-to-print sizes from 1×1 up to 5×5, with both door orientations for every rectangle, plus 2 height/fit specials. Parametric SCAD source included — change pitch, height, or footprint to derive any size you want (the SCAD goes well past 5×5).

items.title: Mead hall box — a Viking longhouse whose whole roof lifts off
items.summary: A 199 mm Viking longhouse whose whole shingled roof lifts off, leaving a 177 x 83 x 31 mm box with the hollow roof above it. Two prints in one wood-fill filament, no supports, no hardware, nothing to glue. Every plank, knot and shingle is cut and jittered from one seed, so it reads hand-built. The roof rests on a tongue, it does not latch, so it is a table box, not a travelling one.

items.title: Pirate treasure chest — print-in-place hinged trinket box, two colour
items.summary: A 100 mm barrel-top pirate chest that comes off the bed as one working unit. The piano hinge prints in place, so there is no assembly, no pin to fit and no glue. Two-colour for the AMS: wood planks plus iron straps, banding, corner brackets, lock plate and hasp.

items.title: Potion of Holding — Twist-Lock Flask Organizer (2 sizes)
items.summary: A fantasy potion flask that twist-locks apart into a wide-mouth bin with a 4-way divider — four sorted compartments for screws, bolts, beads, pills, or tiny treasure. A friction cork plugs the neck. Two sizes from the same design: a full-size desk organizer and a mini that fits inside a 2.7-inch gacha capsule.

items.title: Pumpkin Box — Realistic Two-Colour Lidded Pumpkin, Holds a Ø80 × 70 mm Jar
items.summary: Ten-lobe pumpkin box, 131 mm wide, sculpted lobes and a gnarled green stem. Lid lifts off at the shoulder; the body swallows an 80 mm jar or candle. Two colours in one lid file, no supports. The lobes are uneven, so the lid matches the body in one rotation only.

items.title: Tool Organizer — 4x4 Hex-Window Stand (parametric OpenSCAD)
items.summary: Upright stand with 16 slots (4x4) for rasps, files, screwdrivers, pens, bits. Hex windows in the middle band let you see what's inside; solid top/bottom keep tools separated.

items.title: Rhombic Dodecahedron Box — one part printed twice, magnets sealed inside
items.summary: A 64 mm rhombic dodecahedron that opens at its equator. ONE STL, printed twice — the halves are congruent, not mirrored. Eight Ø4×2 magnets are enclosed mid-print: no glue, nothing visible, nothing to fall out. Stacks like cannonballs.

items.title: Rose Drawer Box — Ornate Flower Trinket Cabinet (2-Colour)
items.summary: A little single-drawer cabinet with a sculpted 3D rose as the drawer pull and engraved flower-vine art on every face. Prints in one colour or as a crisp 2-colour AMS set.

items.title: Rut Box — a keepsake box locked shut by two stags' antlers
items.summary: A 108 x 62 x 84 mm hunting keepsake box with a 64 ml cavity. Four antler racks — two on the base, two on the lid — interleave when the box is closed, like two stags with their horns locked in the rut. A quarter turn sweeps the racks apart and releases a bayonet lock. No hardware, no supports, no glue.

items.title: Stackable Lattice Basket — 4 Sizes + Parametric SCAD
items.summary: Cross-stackable lattice baskets with cone-peg corner posts — any basket stacks onto any other basket. Four ready-to-print sizes from 5×5×5 cm cube up to a 20×12×8 cm tray, plus an optional cone-foot leg accessory. One open short side per basket so you can reach contents while the stack stays put. Parametric SCAD included — override basket_l/basket_w/body_h to derive any size; corner-post + peg geometry is shared so derived sizes still cross-stack with the printed ones.

items.title: Stackable Server Rack — Tool-Free Mini-PC / NUC / SBC Shelf
items.summary: A modular, tool-free rack for mini-PCs, NUCs, SBCs and other small servers. Each level is a honeycomb-vented floor on four fat corner posts; levels self-stack on cone pegs (no screws, no hardware) and four wide feet lift the whole tower off the desk for airflow. Print one floor per device, four feet once, stack as tall as you like. Parametric SCAD — resize for any box.

items.title: Star Box with Pull-Handle Lid (Parametric)
items.summary: A 5-point star trinket box with a friction-fit lid — choose a plain flush lid or a lid with a grab-and-hang loop handle. Fully parametric OpenSCAD source.

items.title: Sugar Skull Box — Calavera Trinket Box (2 Parts, No Supports)
items.summary: A Day-of-the-Dead calavera trinket box that splits at the brow — the cranium lifts off as a lid. Two printed parts, slip-fit lip, no supports, no hardware. 62 × 58 × 74 mm closed, ~37 cm³ inside. Optional AMS two-colour inlay.

items.title: Trojan Horse Box — rolling, openable treasure horse
items.summary: A wooden Trojan-horse keepsake box on real rolling wheels, with a hinged belly compartment — open it to reveal what you smuggled inside. NOTE: the hidden compartment is TINY (31 × 15 × 13 mm) — ring / note / tooth sized, not a storage box.

items.title: Truchet Bucket Box — 5-Compartment Organizer with Maze-Pattern Walls
items.summary: A lidless 5-bucket organizer with a flowing Truchet-tile maze pattern engraved on all four walls. Great for beads, hardware, ball bearings, craft bits. No supports, prints flat. Fully parametric OpenSCAD source included — change bucket count, size, or pattern.

items.title: Bayonet Tube — Ø50 × 60 mm with Quarter-Turn Locking Caps
items.summary: Cylindrical tube container with two IDENTICAL bayonet caps. Drop a cap on either end, push, twist 35°, locked. No hardware, no supports. Parametric OpenSCAD source included.

items.title: Amber Mosquito Pendant — Mosquito Suspended Inside a Translucent Lump, 2-Colour, No Supports
items.summary: A mosquito embedded inside a lump of translucent 'amber'. Two filaments, no cavity and no glue — the insect is a second solid that the slicer prints inside the first. 33 x 30 x 7.5 mm, Ø3.5 bail, prints flat with no supports. Honest warning: the inclusion reads softly, and best when the pendant is held against the light.

items.title: Animal Silhouette Coasters — 20 Species (90mm)
items.summary: Set of 20 animal-silhouette drink coasters: capybara, hippo, beaver, fox, wolf, bear, otter, rabbit, stag, elephant, raccoon, cat, sloth, owl, eagle, penguin, dolphin, whale, octopus, turtle. Two-color AMS print, 90 mm disc.

items.title: Antler Drop Earrings — Red Deer Rack
items.summary: A red-deer rack shrunk to a 26 mm drop earring. Mirrored left and right pieces, flat on the bed face-up, no supports, 0.44 g each. Ø2.5 mm bore already sized for a 4 mm jump ring.

items.title: Mini Anvil Earring — 3D Blacksmith Anvil Charm
items.summary: A tiny London-pattern anvil earring, modelled fully in the round — tapered horn, overhanging working face, waisted body and spread base — with a pierced heel eye for a jump ring. Prints supportless on its side. Parametric OpenSCAD source included.

items.title: Articulated Worm Dangle Earring — Print-in-Place Flexi Worm
items.summary: A tiny ~38 mm print-in-place worm that actually wiggles and sways when worn. Five segments linked by captive teardrop ball-socket joints — printed flat, belly-down, NO supports, then flexed free. Friendly face with eyes + an engraved smile, and a flat ear loop in the bed plane so it hangs in classic worm side profile. Print twice for a pair.

items.title: Auxetic Grip Pad — Rotating-Squares Metamaterial (parametric, 4 sizes + coupon)
items.summary: A flat, supportless auxetic grip pad — a sheet of rigid square tiles joined to their neighbours by thin living-hinge necks in a checkerboard, so it has a negative Poisson ratio (nu ~= -1): pull it and it expands on BOTH axes instead of necking in. That makes it go synclastic — drape it over a jar lid or dome and it caps the curve and hugs it instead of wrinkling, so it grips. Bundled at 4 grid sizes (3x3, 6x5, 8x8, 10x10), plus a 3x3 test coupon and the full parametric OpenSCAD source — change the grid, tile pitch, hinge width and thickness and re-render any size you like. Print in PETG or TPU: the necks are living hinges and PLA fatigue-cracks.

items.title: Baroque Pearl Hoop Earring — Print-in-Place Sliding Pearls
items.summary: A hoop earring strung with six irregular baroque pearls that really slide around it — printed in one piece, no assembly, no supports, no jump rings between the parts.

items.title: Bat Ceiling Hook — hangs by its own feet, head down, like a real bat
items.summary: A roosting bat that hooks over a ceiling hook by its two toe-rings and gives you two open claw hooks at the bottom for cords, string lights or a planter. One part, no supports, no assembly.

items.title: Beawhistle — beaver whistle, loud twin-chamber, one piece, no supports
items.summary: A beaver standing on its tail with a chewed stick in its teeth that is also a loud pealess whistle: blow into the stick, the sound leaves two slots between its shoulder blades. Two stopped-pipe chambers of unequal length pulse against each other — measured on the printed part at 2205 Hz with a ~70 Hz warble, the Fox-40 architecture. 99 x 26 x 50 mm, one piece, print-in-place, no supports, no hardware.

items.title: Biohazard Coasters — raised trefoil that lets go of a wet glass, plus caddy
items.summary: Ø90 mm coaster set with the biohazard trefoil standing 0.8 mm proud of the drink face, so a cold wet glass rests on three lobes and never suctions to the floor. Two-colour AMS file with the six-island mark pre-welded into ONE part, a single-colour version, and a stacking caddy for four. No supports.

items.title: Literary Hero Bookmarks — 15 Silhouettes (16×70mm)
items.summary: Set of 15 literary-character bookmarks: Sherlock, Dracula, Gandalf, Smaug, Frodo, Hook, Raven, Cheshire Cat, Alice, White Rabbit, Hamlet, Robin Hood, Long John Silver, Mad Hatter, Phoenix. Slim 1.2 mm strip, silhouette topper, tassel hole.

items.title: Mr Rodent — Top-Hat Earring Charm
items.summary: Tiny top-hat rodent pendant for earrings/necklaces — 22 mm tall, jump-ring hole ready, two-color AMS print (body + gold hat).

items.title: Sleeping Cat Key Bowl
items.summary: Curled-up cat sculpt whose body forms a shallow bowl — drop your keys, rings, or coins into the natural depression in the cat's curl. Ø85 × ~41 mm, single-piece, no supports.

items.title: Cerberus leash hook — three-headed hellhound wall plaque with hidden magnets
items.summary: A three-headed hellhound wall plaque where each open jaw is a hook. Five magnets sit fully sealed inside the body, dropped in at a print pause, so the back face is one unbroken plane with no bores, no glue and nothing to fall out.

items.title: Chainmail Coaster — 8 cm flexible print-in-place grid
items.summary: 80×80 mm drink coaster built from 11×11 print-in-place cube hubs, each linked to its neighbours by tilted ring pairs. Prints in one go, comes off the bed as a flexible chainmail fabric that drapes under a glass.

items.title: Climbing Monkey — Classic Rope-Climbing Pull Toy
items.summary: Pull the two beads alternately and the monkey ratchets up the cords toward his banana — let go and he stays put, slacken both cords and he slides back down. No springs, no glue, no mechanism to assemble: pure capstan friction through 45° paw channels. 3 printed parts + string. Prints flat, no supports. Kid-safe: Ø33 mm beads pass the choke gauge.

items.title: Mandala Coasters — 5 Geometric Patterns (92mm)
items.summary: Set of 5 parametric mandala-pattern drink coasters. Sun wheel, lotus, star lattice, rosace, and ornate — all open-strut designs that print with no supports.

items.title: Cyclo Planter — Vietnamese xích lô succulent pot that rolls
items.summary: A Vietnamese cyclo (cycle rickshaw) as a small rolling planter: the passenger seat is the pot, the footboard is the drip tray, the driver's rack holds three cups for cuttings. 9 STLs, 16 press-fit pieces, no glue, no supports, no hardware. Wheels spin, cranks snap on, the hood bow doubles as a trellis. Printed and assembled — full illustrated guide below. Designed from scratch in OpenSCAD for the Custom Cyclo Challenge.

items.title: Dachshund Earring — 3D Wiener Dog Charm
items.summary: A genuinely 3D little sausage dog charm — a plump barrel body, long snout, two floppy ears, four stubby legs and a jaunty up-curl tail, rounded on every side so it reads like a dog from any angle (not a flat relief). Prints belly-down, flat on the bed, NO supports. A jump-ring bail on the back ridge hangs it level. Single dog + a matched left/right pair STL in the download.

items.title: Deathly Hallows Fridge Magnet
items.summary: The three Deathly Hallows as a slim fridge magnet — Cloak triangle, Resurrection-Stone circle, Elder-Wand line. Three Ø5×3 mm magnets are sealed invisibly inside the rounded corners during a single print pause: no glue, no exposed metal, either face sticks to the fridge.

items.title: Dendrite Lace Earrings — Every Seed Grows a Different One
items.summary: A generative lace-disc earring. The web is grown by a seeded random algorithm, so changing one number in the source gives you an earring nobody else has. Two structures included (crazed-glaze and coral), both 27 mm, both print flat with no supports in about 20 minutes. Print the same file twice for a matched pair.

items.title: Sleeping Dragon Ring Holder — crystal spire, 3 colours, no supports
items.summary: A small dragon asleep in a coil around a crystal spire on a rock. Rings slide over the crystal and rest on the dragon's back. Three separate prints in three colours that drop together with no glue and no hardware, or one print-in-place 3-colour file for an AMS. 53 x 53 x 64 mm, about 46 g, no supports.

items.title: Dino Femur Bone Earring Charm — Mirrored Pair
items.summary: A tiny dinosaur femur bone charm with a built-in jump-ring loop on the upper knuckle. Ships as a mirrored pair for earrings. About 20 mm tall, prints standing with no supports. Companion to the T-rex skull charm.

items.title: Fiddlehead Fern Earring — Unfurling Frond Charm
items.summary: A tightly coiled fiddlehead (young fern frond / crozier) as a sculpted earring charm: fine spiral ridges on the coil, delicate frond pinnae bristling along a fluted stem, and an integrated loop at the top for a jump ring. Printed and worn. Prints flat, one piece.

items.title: Flexi Snake — print-in-place articulated fidget that coils
items.summary: A print-in-place snake that prints in one piece, no supports, and coils into a full spiral in your hand. 16 necked vertebrae on captive ball-and-stalk joints, each folding 50-70 degrees, plus a carved head with eyes and scale rings. Fully parametric: dial the number of segments and their length right in the .scad.

items.title: Retro Daisy Flower Earrings — 3-Color Charm
items.summary: Parametric multi-color daisy earring charm — a 6-petal flower with a half-step inner petal ring and a domed center button, all welded in one flat ~25 mm print. Hanging hole bored through the top petal. Prints flat, support-free. Ships a pre-colored 3MF (drag in, already split + colored) plus a combined STL for Split-to-Parts. Print twice for a pair.

items.title: Fly Agaric Mushroom Earring — 2-Color Charm
items.summary: Parametric Amanita muscaria (fly agaric) earring charm — a red domed cap with scattered white warts on a white volva stem with a drooping veil ring. Two-color for AMS: the white spots are cut as complementary dimples in the red cap, so the colors tile perfectly with no overlap and no holes through the body. Prints standing, cap up, support-free. Ships a combined STL with 2 named solids for Split-to-Parts. Print twice for a pair.

items.title: Gargoyle Wall Hook
items.summary: Gothic gargoyle head on a round backplate — wall-mounted hook for towels, rags, keys, charms. Protruding face acts as the hook; drape items over it. Two screw holes for drywall mount.

items.title: Giraffe Earring — 2-Color AMS, Print-in-One, Both Facings
items.summary: Full-body giraffe drop earring, 44 mm, sculpted with a flat back and a ring lug above the ossicones. Two coordinate-locked color solids in one STL: split to parts, assign cream and brown, print flat with no supports. Ships left-facing and right-facing so a pair can look the same way or at each other.

items.title: Bearrings
items.summary: Grizzly bear earring charms — a standing grizzly about 28 mm tall with a jump-ring bail baked into the crown so it hangs facing forward. Print a pair for earrings or one for a pendant.

items.title: Half-Amphora Brooch — a real amphora, full of flowers, cut in half
items.summary: A magnetic brooch, 44 x 58 mm. Not an illusion and not a flat silhouette: a proper amphora is turned as a body of revolution, given two handles and a spray of flowers, and then cut in half on the plane of the brooch's back. What is left is 6 mm of true 3D relief with a flat back. The halving is also the print trick — a solid of revolution cut on its axis plane has zero overhang anywhere, so it prints face up with no supports. Two printed pieces, four colours, sealed magnets, no pin.

items.title: Halloween Coasters — six motifs that hold the glass 0.6 mm off the coaster, plus a pumpkin caddy
items.summary: Ø90 mm Halloween coaster set: jack-o'-lantern, ghost, bat across a full moon, spider web, skull and cauldron. Every motif stands 0.6 mm PROUD of the drink face, so a cold wet glass rests on it with air underneath and never sticks and lifts the coaster with it. Two-colour AMS files that split into exactly two parts, a single-colour version of each, and a ribbed pumpkin caddy that stacks five fully, with the sixth above the rim. No supports anywhere.

items.title: Hollow-Face Vase Brooch — the vase is a hole, and it follows you
items.summary: A magnetic brooch, 47 x 55 mm. The vase is not raised — it is the exact mould of a vase, sunk 5.2 mm into the plaque. Your eye refuses to read it as hollow, so it bulges out instead, and appears to turn and follow whoever walks past. Nothing moves; the viewer does. Two printed pieces, four colours in one 0.6 mm band, sealed magnets, no pin.

items.title: Wand Through the Wall — a Straight Wand Passes Through a Curved Slit
items.summary: A dead-straight wand on a little turntable swings clean through two CURVED slits in a wall, twice per turn, without bending. The wand is skew to the axis, so it sweeps a hyperboloid; the wall cuts that in a hyperbola, and that is the slit. Four flat supportless parts, formula engraved on the base.

items.title: Infinity Cube — Animal Fidget (folding magic cube, 48 engraved animals, two-colour)
items.summary: A folding infinity cube (magic cube) fidget toy: eight cubelets linked so you can fold it end over end forever. Every one of the 48 faces carries a different animal silhouette. Prints fully assembled — the links are captured by the cube geometry, not glued — and the animals come as a separate inlay STL so you can print them in a contrast colour. Confirmed printed and everting on a real machine.

items.title: Jonah Whale - Press the Blowhole to Open the Jaw
items.summary: A print-in-place whale toy. Press its blowhole and the jaw drops open to reveal a tiny diver.

items.title: Kakapo Earring Charm — Chubby NZ Parrot Pendant
items.summary: Chubby kakapo (ground parrot from NZ) charm with hanging loop — earring, necklace, or keychain-mini. Heads-up: the jump-ring loop is thin and can snap under rough handling.

items.title: Kangaroo Desk Organizer
items.summary: Standing kangaroo with an open belly pouch that catches keys, AirPods, change, or small items. 52×85×120 mm tripod stance. Single-piece, no supports.

items.title: Viking Longship Charm — Earring & Pendant
items.summary: Chunky stylized drakkar charm with dragon-head prow, shield row and stern spiral. 32 mm earring size plus a 45 mm pendant scale and a ready-to-print pair plate. Jump-ring bore already drilled through the mane.

items.title: Luna Moth Earring — Flat Silhouette Charm
items.summary: Parametric Luna moth (Actias luna) silhouette earring: broad swept forewings, the signature long curling swallowtail hindwing tails, four eyespot through-holes, tapered antennae, and a bail loop for a jump ring. Prints FLAT in one piece — zero overhangs, no supports. Symmetric, so print twice for a pair.

items.title: Marble Run — Print-in-Place Roman-Greek Track
items.summary: One-shot print-in-place marble run with a 3-pin plinko mid-section, sloped chute finish, and integrated Roman column supports. Greek-key meander engravings on all outer walls. Ships with a standalone start-hopper accessory + start/finish flag pair.

items.title: Melting Candle Earring — 2-Color Charm
items.summary: Parametric dripping wax candle earring charm — a tapered candle body with a melted pool rim, six irregular wax drips ending in bulbous drops, a teardrop flame and an integral hanging loop. Two-color for AMS: ivory wax body + orange flame as two named solids for Split-to-Parts. Prints STANDING, flame up, support-free (wide base on the bed, everything narrows upward). Print twice for a pair.

items.title: Möbius Hoop Earrings — Twisted Ribbon, Prints Flat, No Supports
items.summary: A hoop that is a real Möbius band: a 6 mm ribbon swept round a 30 mm circle, three half-twists. No supports.

items.title: Monk pangolin — meditating pangolin figurine with mala beads
items.summary: A pangolin sat in meditation: prayer hands, a string of mala beads, a robe with a tassel and the tail curled round the base. 50 mm tall, one part, prints flat on the base.

items.title: Morse Code Earring — Any Word, Reads Down
items.summary: Parametric Morse-code earring: each letter becomes one horizontal row of dots and dashes, stacked top-to-bottom on a central strand so the word reads straight down the charm. Any A-Z / 0-9 word swaps in via one variable. Prints FLAT, face up, support-free — every feature is a round dot or stadium dash. 12 ready-made words included (LOVE, SOS, DREAM, STAR, ...). Symmetric, so print twice for a pair.

items.title: Narwhistle — narwhal whistle, loud twin-chamber, one piece, no supports
items.summary: A narwhal standing on its flukes on an ice floe that is also a loud pealess whistle: blow into the tusk, the sound leaves the blowhole. Two stopped-pipe chambers of unequal length pulse against each other — measured on the printed part at 2266 Hz with a ~66 Hz warble, the Fox-40 architecture. 102 x 40 x 31 mm, one piece, print-in-place, no supports, no hardware.

items.title: Nudibranch Earring — 4-Color AMS Sea Slug, Print-in-One
items.summary: Blue-and-orange aeolid sea slug charm, 36 mm, hanging head-up from a ring on its head. Four coordinate-locked colour solids in one STL: split to parts, assign white, blue, orange, brown, print flat with no supports.

items.title: Oldham Coupling Fidget — Offset-Shaft Constant-Velocity Demo Toy
items.summary: A desk fidget that demos the Oldham coupling: spin the bottom knob and the top knob tracks it 1:1 even though the two shafts are parallel but laterally offset. A floating middle disc carries the rotation while its centre orbits a little circle. Five printed parts (4 unique designs), all flat and supportless. Useless, just fun.

items.title: Owlbear Candle & Pen Holder — Chunky D&D Desk Sculpt
items.summary: A round, grumpy owlbear (the classic owl-bear) as a chunky desk sculpt with a deep central bore — sized to hold a taper candle or a fistful of pens and pencils. Sculpted feathered belly, tufted ears, and a hooked beak. Prints like a vase: flat base, cavity opens up, no supports.

items.title: Panda Earring Charm — 2-Color AMS, Print-in-One
items.summary: Seated giant-panda charm, 29.7 mm tall, sculpted with a flat back. Two coordinate-locked color solids in one STL: split to parts, assign white and black, print flat with no supports.

items.title: Parasaurolophus Skull Capsule — clamshell trinket / pill box
items.summary: A detailed Parasaurolophus dinosaur skull that splits at the mouth and swings open on a hidden snap-together hinge, revealing a small interior pocket — a keepsake capsule for a pill, a tiny charm, a ring, or a rolled note. Two printed parts, no glue, no hardware. Printed in PETG.

items.title: Patronus Stag — Ring Holder Bust
items.summary: Stylized stag head bust on a round pedestal — wearable ring/jewelry holder, also a clean desk decoration. 4-tine antlers angled to cradle rings; flat bottom, prints upright with no supports.

items.title: Phoenix Earring Charm — perched firebird (mirrored pair)
items.summary: A majestic perched phoenix charm for earrings or pendants, about 32 mm tall, with a jump-ring bail baked into the nape so it hangs upright. Ships as a mirrored left/right pair so both birds face outward. Styled after a Fawkes-like firebird — a swept-back crest, swan-curved neck, folded wings and a long fanned tail that becomes the dangle.

items.title: Piggy Bank 🐷 — top coin slot + finger-twist bottom plug
items.summary: A classic chubby piggy bank: drop coins through the top slot (takes any circulating coin up to Ø33 mm), empty it by unscrewing the knurled bottom plug with your fingers — no tool. The pig prints as ONE belly-down body (snout, ears, curly tail, feet all integral) plus a separate twist plug. Watertight, no supports. Parametric OpenSCAD source included.

items.title: Pomeranian Dog Earring Charm
items.summary: A chibi sitting Pomeranian charm for earrings or necklaces. About 24 mm tall with a jump-ring bail baked in behind the ears so it hangs facing forward. Prints standing — supports recommended.

items.title: Pop-Up Toaster — Toy with a REAL Spring-Launched Pop
items.summary: A pretend-play toaster that actually works: press the side lever DOWN and it clicks down and latches; push the side EJECT buttons and POP — both toast slices spring up out of the slots. Real printed coil springs and a self-engaging sear latch, just like a 1950s toaster. No glue, snap-together, kid-safe energy budget.

items.title: Pythagorean Cup — Greedy Cup / Cup of Justice (parametric)
items.summary: Drink from it normally and it works like any cup; fill it past the 'greedy line' and the entire contents siphon out the bottom. Attributed to Pythagoras (~6th c. BC) — a working hidden-siphon trick cup. Parametric SCAD: change cup_d / cup_h to resize.

items.title: Raven Skull Earring — flat silhouette dangle, mirrored pair, no supports
items.summary: A raven (Corvus corax) skull in lateral profile as a flat dangle earring: a big domed braincase pierced by an Ø8 orbit, the heavy decurved corvid culmen with an open nare, and a mandible fused only at the articulation so an open jaw slot runs the length of the beak — that slot is what makes it read as a skull rather than a bird head. One flat piece, ~25 x 41 x 1.8 mm, 0.93 g, printed face-up with zero overhangs and no supports. Ships mirrored left and right STLs so a worn pair both faces outward, and a fully parametric OpenSCAD source: size, thickness, hang angle, orbit and nare, bail hole.

items.title: Remembrall Memory Orb Earring — 3-Color Smoke-Gem Charm
items.summary: A faceted smoke-gem memory orb as a 3-color earring charm: a translucent red glass orb wrapped by a gold equatorial band of porthole dots, with a gold hanging bail on top. Prints in one piece on an AMS / multi-material printer — drop in the combined STL and Split-to-Parts, or print the per-color STLs separately. ~14 mm orb, support-free, print twice for a pair.

items.title: Nordic Rune Coasters — 12 motifs, carved rope lip, runic caddy
items.summary: Ø90 mm Norse coasters with a twisted-rope lip, wood grain carved across the well and one of 12 motifs engraved in the middle — six Elder Futhark runes, six Norse icons. Each ships with an exact-fit inlay for two-colour AMS printing. Plus a stacking caddy whose wall carries a real runic inscription. No supports anywhere.

items.title: Chibi Seal Earring Charms — Mirrored Pair
items.summary: Chubby baby-seal charm pair with built-in hanging loops — 20 mm body, mirrored left/right, prints flat on the belly with no supports. Add jump rings + ear hooks for earrings, or hang one on a chain as a pendant.

items.title: Great White Shark Earring Charm — Bites the Ring
items.summary: A realistic sleek great-white shark charm that bites a jump-ring held in its mouth. The ring is the hang point, so it wears nose-up / tail-down. About 37 x 66 x 25 mm. NOTE: the thin fins are very brittle — handle gently and print with supports.

items.title: Snowflake Set — Ornament · Coaster · Fridge Magnet · Earrings · Print-in-Place Cuff (Parametric)
items.summary: A family of 6-fold dendrite snowflakes from one parametric generator: a tree ornament, an openwork drink coaster, a sealed-in fridge magnet, dainty earrings, a single cord charm, and a print-in-place hinged bracelet cuff that folds off the bed already articulated and locks with a toggle clasp. All print FLAT, face-down, NO supports.

items.title: AC/DC Socket Plug — EU Child-Safety Blanker
items.summary: Round disc that fills the recess of a EU Schuko/CEE 7/3 wall socket and blocks both phase holes. Two big spherical finger pockets on the dome let you pry it back out one-handed; a U-slot at one edge wraps around the earth pin so the plug seats flush in grounded sockets. Two-colour print: dark body + yellow lightning-bolt inlay on the dome (AC/DC theme). Ø 38 mm × 19 mm dome.

items.title: Spider Drop Earring — the spider actually SWINGS on its dragline
items.summary: An orb web with a spider hanging below it on a dragline that is a real pivot, not a printed line. The dragline's top end is an eye captured on a post at the web hub and closed by a cap, so the spider is a free pendulum that swings side to side as you move. Print-in-place: one flat plate, two bodies, no supports, nothing to assemble. 20.0 x 40.1 x 4.9 mm, ~0.6 g. Print two for a pair.

items.title: Strigoi bust — Romanian folklore vampire, one part, no supports
items.summary: A strigoi — the Romanian-folklore vampire — as a small shelf bust: gaunt skull, deep-set eyes under a heavy brow, hooked nose, ears swept back to points, jaw hanging open on two long canines, and a folk-embroidered collar of cross-stitch diamonds that is the Carpathian tell separating a strigoi from a generic Dracula. 70.7 x 42.0 x 49.0 mm, one part, one colour, prints flat on its plinth with no supports, no glue and no hardware.

items.title: Strix Owl Earring Charm
items.summary: A finely detailed horned-owl charm for earrings or pendants, about 25 mm tall with a jump-ring bail baked into the crown. Note: the photographed pair was printed in wood-fill PLA, which is NOT recommended for a piece this small and detailed — plain or silk PLA gives far cleaner results.

items.title: Sushi Maki Roll Earring (3-color maki sushi charm)
items.summary: Tiny parametric maki-roll sushi earring — hand-rolled irregular outline, individual rice grains on the cut face, nori overlap seam. 3-color AMS, print-in-one, support-free.

items.title: Sushi Nigiri Earring (3-color salmon nigiri charm)
items.summary: Tiny parametric salmon-nigiri sushi earring — textured rice grains, marbled salmon, dark nori strap. 3-color AMS, print-in-one, support-free.

items.title: Tank Shooter — chunky display tank, print-in-place tracks
items.summary: A chunky stylised T-34-ish display tank: articulated print-in-place link tracks that wrap the road wheels, a rotating turret, and a cosmetic gun with a friction-seated dummy shell. No glue, no supports, no hardware, AMS multi-colour. A DISPLAY model — the tracks don't drive and the gun doesn't fire.

items.title: Tengwar Wall Clock — Elvish Duodecimal Numerals
items.summary: A Ø200 mm round wall clock with twelve authentic Tengwar duodecimal hour numerals and elvish leaf-blade hands. A real clock, not a flat disc: an integrated standoff back wall hides the quartz movement and a rear deep-channel keyhole hangs it on a single ordinary wall screw. Numerals + ticks can be paint-filled or printed as second/third AMS colours. Prints face-down, no supports.

items.title: Tiny Book Earring — a wearable book that really opens, print-in-place hinge, no supports
items.summary: A book small enough to wear that actually opens. One print-in-place piece: two covers on a seven-knuckle piano hinge with a captive pin, a hollow page cavity inside, and ONCE UPON engraved on the inner cover so the message only shows when you open it. 22 x 17.6 x 4.2 mm closed, 1.55 g, about 25 minutes, no supports and no hardware beyond an ear wire. Comes off the plate open flat; fold it once and it clicks shut on a printed detent bead, and a thumbnail in the fore-edge scallop pops it open again. Fully parametric OpenSCAD source — size, cover thickness, hinge clearance, detent grip and the engraved message are all variables.

items.title: Toadstool 🍄 — twist-open bonbon capsule
items.summary: A tiny Amanita-muscaria toadstool that twists open to hide a wrapped bonbon or candy inside. The red spotted cap is a screw-off roof; underneath is a clean toadstool stalk — Amanita skirt ring and a soft volva bulb at the base — with a hollow chamber. Two-colour AMS cap. Closed capsule is Ø46 × 52 mm (min sphere Ø58 mm) — fits inside a 2.7-inch (68.6 mm) capsule. No supports, parametric OpenSCAD source included.

items.title: Tower of Hanoi — Parametric Educational Stacking Puzzle
items.summary: Classic recursion puzzle: move a graduated stack of discs across three pegs, one at a time, never a bigger disc on a smaller one. Parametric (n_discs 3–9, default 5); print each disc a different colour for a rainbow set and the base in wood-fill PLA for the grain shown. Kid-safe: smallest disc above the choke gauge, every edge filleted. Prints flat, no supports.

items.title: Trammel of Archimedes — Do-Nothing Machine Fidget
items.summary: A classic 'do-nothing machine': a gloriously useless desk fidget. Crank the knob and the arm traces a perfect ellipse over an engraved groove — and that's it, it does nothing else, forever. Two dovetail sliders shuttle in perpendicular channels; a knobbed crank arm snaps onto both. 3 unique parts (print the slider twice), all flat, no supports. Honest heads-up: the motion is not glass-smooth — at the crossroad a slider can catch and need a tiny nudge.

items.title: T-Rex Skull Earring Charm — Mirrored Pair
items.summary: A detailed T-rex skull charm with a built-in jump-ring loop on the cranium. Ships as a mirrored pair for earrings. About 32 mm long, prints standing with tree supports for the jaw. Companion to the dino femur bone charm.

items.title: Trident Bookmark — Poseidon's Trident with a Page Stop (2-colour)
items.summary: Poseidon's trident as a bookmark: the haft IS the page strip, and the 30 mm crossbar rests on the page block so it can never sink into the book. Prints flat at 1.2 mm, no supports. Single-colour or two-colour.

items.title: Trojan Horse Earring — Wooden Horse of Troy
items.summary: The wooden horse of Troy as a wearable charm — a wheeled-plank Trojan Horse pendant. Two flavours in one download: a flat engraved silhouette that prints supportless, and an in-the-round 3D horse on a roller cart.

items.title: Twisted Vortex Bowl — one part, no supports
items.summary: A catch-all bowl whose flutes spiral out of a small foot into a wide rim. The flutes climb at the same angle everywhere, so nothing on the outside of the bowl overhangs past 36 degrees and it prints with no supports and no brim. 46 mm foot, 78 mm rim, 45 mm tall, holds about 115 ml, around 30 g. Parametric OpenSCAD source included — twist, flare, flute pitch and depth are all named variables at the top.

items.title: Gramophone Trinket Box + Matching Charm — Victrola Horn Phonograph
items.summary: A horn-gramophone trinket box with a front-loading drawer hidden in the cabinet, plus the same phonograph shrunk into a wearable charm. Print the 66 mm box, the 34 mm earring, or both — no supports on either.

items.title: Viola Earring — 4-Color AMS Pansy Blossom, Print-in-One
items.summary: Viola (pansy) blossom charm, 28 mm, hanging from a ring above the upper petals. Four coordinate-locked colour solids in one STL: split to parts, assign magenta, violet, yellow, dark, print flat with no supports.

items.title: Ship's-Wheel Earring — Free-Spinning, Print-in-Place
items.summary: A miniature ship's-wheel (helm) charm whose wheel actually spins on its bail. Printed as ONE support-free job: the wheel comes off the bed already captive on a fixed axle between a foot and a top cap. Flat print, vertical axle, so every wheel-to-frame clearance is a clean horizontal gap — no supports, no teardrop bore. Symmetric — print twice for a pair.
