items.title: Weather Dial Fridge Magnet — spin it to today's weather
items.summary: A fridge magnet with a live front. Thumb the knurled rim through the side notch and the dial clicks into four detented positions — sun, rain, cloud, snow — showing one icon at a time through the porthole. The three magnets are sealed inside solid plastic on both faces: no glue, no exposed metal against the door, nothing to fall out. They go in during the print, at a single pause. The dial ships as five files sharing one coordinate frame, so it prints in five colours with nothing to group by hand. Prints supportless. Parametric OpenSCAD source included.

items.title: Gothic Pigtail Girl Silhouette Earring — Flat Charm
items.summary: A flat full-body silhouette of a somber girl in braided pigtails and a dark dress, sized as a dangle earring charm with an integral bail loop at the crown. Prints FLAT on its back, face up — zero overhangs, no supports. About 42 mm tall. Print twice for a pair.

items.title: Winged Sandal Earrings — Hermes' talaria, flat two-colour pair
items.summary: The winged sandal of Hermes (talaria, the 'Mercury foot') as a flat two-colour dangle earring — sole, up-curled toe and an ankle strap that arcs up and becomes the bail, with a feathered heel wing in a second colour. Both colours tile ONE flat plate at the same height, so they print flush in the same layers with no step, no overlap and no supports. ~35 mm tall, 2.2 mm thick, about 2 g for the pair. Mirrored L+R so the toes point outward when worn.

items.title: Wizard Figurine — robed mage with a magnet hand
items.summary: A robed wizard figurine with a pointed wide-brim hat, long beard and one hand raised in greeting. The raised hand has a recessed slot for a small disc magnet, so he can hold a metal wand, pin or trinket. It is NOT a fridge magnet — the figure will not stick to a fridge, and the little magnet is weak, so think of it as a charming desk or shelf wizard with a handy magnetic hand. Ships as an STL plus a ready-to-slice Bambu .3mf.

items.title: Yggdrasil Buttons — Norse world-tree sewing buttons, 15 / 20 / 25 mm, shank or 2-hole
items.summary: Real, wearable sewing buttons with the Norse world-tree on the face. Five sizes/styles: Ø15, 20, 25 mm with a hidden thread tunnel in the underside (the face stays whole — no holes bored through the tree), plus classic 2-hole versions at Ø15 and 20. Each ships a named-solid 2-colour companion for AMS. Prints flat, face up, no supports, no brim. Fully parametric: any diameter renders with the motif's stroke widths automatically held at or above one nozzle width.

items.title: Zebra Earring — 2-Color AMS, Print-in-One, Both Facings
items.summary: Full-body zebra drop earring, 32 mm, sculpted with a flat back and a ring lug on the crest. Two coordinate-locked color solids in one STL: split to parts, assign white and black, print flat with no supports. Ships left-facing and right-facing so a pair can look the same way or at each other.

items.title: Adjustable Support — Parametric Two-Piece Screw Jack (1× and 2×)
items.summary: Two-piece screw jack with a buttress-style helical thread. Spin the post to extend or retract the height. Bundled in two sizes: original (~Ø36, 20 mm travel range) and 2× scale (~Ø72, 40 mm travel range). Parametric OpenSCAD lets you re-render at any scale_factor. Note: the fit is slightly loose — the thread engages cleanly with about 0.5 mm radial slip per side, which makes the spin feel free rather than tight.

items.title: Amphora Pen Pot — Panathenaic Prize Amphora, Engraved Bands, No Supports
items.summary: A Greek amphora as a desk pen pot: running-athlete frieze, Greek-key meander, ray and palmette bands, all engraved 0.7 mm into the curved wall. One part, prints upright with no supports. The foot is deliberately widened over the museum original so it does not tip when a pen leans.

items.title: Bone Tankard — skeleton cup holder with femur staves & skull
items.summary: A barrel-stave tankard built from bones: 24 randomized cartoon femurs as staves, a relief skull fused into the front, and a bone-chain handle. Drop in a glass or 330 ml can. Prints upright with NO supports. Fully parametric OpenSCAD.

items.title: Desk-Edge Cable Clamp — Clip-On with Printable Thumbscrew
items.summary: A C-clamp that grips the edge of any desk and carries a cable through a C-shaped snap-in hook. Held in place by a fully printable knurled thumbscrew (plastic-on-plastic thread, no metal hardware, no tools). Three-part print.

items.title: Desk Cable Rack — Pegs or Pole Variant (Parametric)
items.summary: A simple desk-side cable rack to keep charging cables, headphones, and props off the floor. Two variants share the same base + back wall: a 6-peg version (each cable hooks over its own peg) and a single-pole version (cables drape over a full-length pole with a back-stop shelf). 200 × 150 × 100 mm. Prints flat on its back, no supports.

items.title: Card Holder — 8 Hero vs Villain Sandwich Pairs
items.summary: 2-piece sandwich card holder for a 55×85 mm card. 8 hero/villain silhouette pairs (Thor/Loki, Knight/Dragon, Red Riding Hood/Wolf, Gandalf/Balrog, Batman/Superman, Cat/Dog, Harry/Voldemort, Vader/Yoda). Friction-post fit — loose and easily disassemblable. Carabiner + keyring holes.

items.title: Classroom Desk Name Plate — slide-in letter tiles, one alphabet sheet spells the whole class
items.summary: A school desk name plate whose name is not baked into the STL. One dovetail track, one tile per letter, threaded in from the open end. Print one alphabet sheet for the whole class and one plate per desk — re-spell it when the seating plan changes instead of re-slicing a custom model for every child. 41 tiles (A-Z plus Czech accented capitals), blanks that centre the name, an end stop that locks the row, and a pair of brackets that stand the plate up as a tent. Every letter also ships as its own file, plain and two-colour. No hardware, no glue, no supports.

items.title: Pocket Comb (3D Printable)
items.summary: A small printable pocket comb with a tapering tooth pattern (fine on one end, wider on the other) and a half-ellipse handle.

items.title: Gothic Stone Throne — decorative sculpture
items.summary: A miniature gothic stone throne: a spired skull-and-scroll backrest, sweeping wave/dragon-wing armrests, and a stepped rune plinth. ~143 × 146 × 211 mm — a chunky display sculpture for a desk, shelf, or D&D table. Prints as one solid watertight body.

items.title: Cup Holder Car — rolling toy coupe with a drink well in the roof
items.summary: A chunky toy coupe whose roof is a real Ø73 mm drink well — decorative AND functional. The four wheels actually roll on captive snap-on axles. No glue, no supports, fully parametric OpenSCAD.

items.title: Cup Holder with Print-in-Place Chain Handle
items.summary: A portable cup / can holder that hangs from a handbag-style chain handle — printed in place, no chain assembly. Skeleton cage cup fits cans and cups up to ~75 mm. Split jump-ring end links clip the chain to the cup horns. Drape it over a door handle, stroller bar, chair arm, or hook.

items.title: Tulip Cup Holder — clamp-on flower drink holder for your desk
items.summary: A blooming tulip that clamps to the edge of your desk and cradles a can, cup or mug. Six overlapping petals form the cup and a leafy stem carries a printed thumbscrew C-clamp. Fully parametric — dial the clamp gap to ANY desk thickness and the screw auto-lengthens to match.

items.title: Lazy-Susan Drink Turntable — 4-cup, drop-in ball bearing
items.summary: A spinning drinks caddy that keeps turning smoothly even loaded with full cups. The cup weight rides on a ring of drop-in steel balls (NOT printed) so friction stays low under load. Print two parts, drop in cheap 8 mm balls, set the top on — done. Four 90 mm cup wells fit mugs and pint glasses. Parametric OpenSCAD source included.

items.title: Cyclo Turntable — 15:1 fine-adjust manual display base
items.summary: A hand-cranked 15:1 cycloidal-drive turntable. Thumb-roll the knurled drum through a side window and the top platform creeps around 15× slower with near-zero backlash — a whole finger swipe nudges your object just 2–4°. Beautiful gearing to fidget with and to watch. Honestly kind of useless: it's a mechanism, not a product — a manual, slow-turning little pedestal. 5 printed parts, no supports, PLA.

items.title: Desk Gyroscope — two-axis gimbal flywheel (a toy, not a tool)
items.summary: A heavy-rim flywheel spinning in a two-axis gimbal on a pedestal — pull the string and the spin axis holds its direction while you tilt the base. A desk toy and physics demonstrator, nothing more.

items.title: Hedgehog Pen & Pencil Holder — your pens become the quills
items.summary: A bald little hedgehog whose quills are YOUR pens and pencils. The smooth dome body has an angled fan of 11 blind bores drilled into its back; plug pens and pencils in and they radiate outward exactly like real quills. Dimple eyes and a snout finish the face. Prints belly-flat on the bed with zero supports — the dome is the top half of an ellipsoid so every wall leans inward going up. Single part, single colour, just print and load it up.

items.title: Keyboard Riser — Split, Dovetail-Joined, Parametric (60 / 100 / 180 mm Lift)
items.summary: Open-frame stand that lifts a keyboard off the desk, leaving the space underneath clear. Three ready-to-print configurations: 60 and 100 mm lift for a 440 × 135 mm board, and 180 mm for a 313 × 123 mm 75 % board (Keychron K2 size). A 3 mm rim keeps the board from sliding off; a honeycomb deck spreads its weight. Too long for a 256 mm bed, so it splits into two halves that re-join with a drop-in dovetail key — no glue, no tools. Fully parametric: change one variable for any other board or height.

items.title: Filigree Letter Opener — Flat Leaf Blade, No Supports
items.summary: A 210 mm single-piece letter opener with a leaf-shaped chisel-ground blade and an ornamental filigree handle (quatrefoil rosette, flanking ovals, hang hole). Prints flat, no supports. PETG recommended for a stiff, durable blade.

items.title: Stacking Letter / A4 Paper Tray — modular, honeycomb floor, 20 swappable nameplates
items.summary: A classic 4-post stacking in-out tray for A4 or Letter paper, sized to fit a 256 mm bed. Paper sits landscape and overhangs the low open front so you can grab a sheet one-handed. Stack as many tiers as you print — corner pegs drop into the tier below. Comes with a pack of 20 clip-on nameplates (IN · OUT · TODO · URGENT · BILLS · CHAOS …) plus a blank one to write on. No screws, no glue, no supports.

items.title: MagDock — Magnetic Desk & Shop Organizer Family
items.summary: A family of small organizers that embed neodymium discs in their backs, so they snap onto ANY ferrous surface — printer frame, fridge, toolbox, filing cabinet, radiator. Hook, tray, tall caddy, pliers/scissors slots, and a bare puck. The magnets are sealed inside DURING printing (mid-print pause), so no caps and no glue. Every part prints flat on its back with NO supports.

items.title: Moku Iris Box — Working Camera-Aperture Catch-All (Base Rail module)
items.summary: A round fluted catch-all box for the Moku modular desk system whose lid is a WORKING 6-blade iris diaphragm — twist the knurled collar and the blades spiral open like a camera aperture onto the cavity (Ø48 mm) for clips, SD cards and coins. Same-plane pinwheel iris: 6 identical rigid blades on pivot posts, drive pins riding radial collar slots, snap-on collar, 1-minute no-order assembly, zero supports. Clips onto the host Base Rail by the reverse-measured foot interface. A remix of the Moku Base Rail by @SabreDesign / @Collecticraft.

items.title: Moku Memo Stand — Sloped Sticky-Note Writing Tray (Base Rail module, 3 sizes)
items.summary: A sloped sticky-note writing tray that clips onto the Moku modular desk-system Base Rail. The pad sits on a 21° incline so the top sheet faces you — read it and write on it in place. Low front rim plus a centre finger-scoop to peel the top sheet; tall back and side rims keep the pad square. Three pad sizes (60 / 80 / 90 mm) and both rail orientations (slide on from the side or front/back) are bundled. Japandi fluted side faces to match the Moku look. A remix of the Moku Base Rail by @SabreDesign / @Collecticraft.

items.title: Moku Cantilever Watch Stand — open 'C' bracket + parametric engraved clock (Base Rail module)
items.summary: A cantilever 'C' watch stand for a chunky sport/dive watch that clips onto the Moku modular desk-system Base Rail. A soft, near-rectangular bracket with smoothly filleted joints: a back spine carries a top arm that cantilevers forward over an open gap, its rest face CANTED ~20° SIDE-TO-SIDE so the watch leans on a dynamic diagonal. The watch sits centred over the base (so a heavy steel watch won't tip it off the rail); the bracelet drapes over the rounded front nose and hangs free, its end on the front shelf. The tall SPINE FRONT face — the back wall of the C, in full view through the opening — carries an ENGRAVED CLOCK FACE with PARAMETRIC hands (set the time in the SCAD, default 10:10) ringed by gear teeth. Every edge is rounded (Japandi). Prints PRINT-ON-END so the cantilever needs no supports and the rail foot prints as crisp vertical channels. A remix of the Moku Base Rail by @SabreDesign / @Collecticraft.

items.title: Paper Block Desk Organizer — Sticky-Note Tray + Pen/Scissor Column + Slot
items.summary: Three-zone desk organizer: thin slot for a phone or notebook on the left, a 90 × 90 mm paper-pad well in the middle (tall back, sloped sides, low front lip with finger-gap), and a pen/scissor column on the right with two-color pencil + scissors icon inlays.

items.title: Pretzel Cable Clip — Two-Colour Desk Cable Holder
items.summary: A 58 x 44 mm pretzel-shaped desk clip for one small charging cable, with white salt accents. Flat print, no supports.

items.title: Radiator Hook — S-Hook for Towel Radiators (No Drilling, No Hardware)
items.summary: A chunky plastic S-hook that slips over the top rail of a heated towel radiator and carries a towel, glove, bag, or keys on the bottom. No drilling, no adhesives, no metal hardware — one-piece print, flat on the bed, no supports.

items.title: Two-Color Ruler — 15 cm + 20 cm (Parametric)
items.summary: Simple two-color ruler with a sloped front edge so the ticks reach the precise measuring edge. Two lengths included (15 cm and 20 cm), each as a body + ink STL pair for AMS multi-filament printing.

items.title: Print-in-Place Spring-Gate Carabiner — keychain clip (PETG)
items.summary: A one-piece print-in-place keychain carabiner. No pin, no separate gate, no spring, no assembly — the body itself is the spring. Push the thin flank inward with your thumb, the gate opens, hook it on, release, it snaps shut. Prints flat with no supports. PETG recommended. NOTE: a light keychain clip for small items only — NOT a safety / climbing / load-bearing carabiner.

items.title: Sunflower Pen Cup — Petal Crown + Gothic Quatrefoil Body
items.summary: Tall pen / marker cup with an 18-petal sunflower crown at the rim and a brick-grid of gothic quatrefoils (cathedral-rose pattern) engraved into the body wall. Single open chamber, prints upright without supports.

items.title: Retro Tape Deck Desk Caddy — pen cups, phone dock, pull-out cassette drawer + swappable spine labels
items.summary: A 1980s stereo cassette deck that is actually a desk organiser. Two 52 mm-deep pen cups, a catch-all tray, a tilted phone cradle with a cable pass-through, and a pull-out 'cassette' drawer whose spine label is a card you thread in sideways and swap. 9 spare captions on one sheet — or letter your own straight from the parametric OpenSCAD source. 3 printed parts, no hardware, no glue, no supports.

items.title: TARDIS Pen Cup — Police Box Storage Container
items.summary: Doctor Who TARDIS / classic English police telephone box. Two-color pen holder with removable roof cap.

items.title: Twisted Ribbed Pen Cup — one part, no supports
items.summary: A rounded-square desk cup whose whole surface is fine ribs turning through 90 degrees from the base to the rim. The cavity twists at the same rate as the shell, so the wall stays 1.6 mm the whole way up and nothing inside collects dust in a corner. 50 x 50 x 70 mm, 63 mm across the twisted corners, about 40 g, one part, no supports, no glue. Parametric OpenSCAD source included — twist angle, rib pitch, rib depth, corner radius and height are all named variables at the top.

items.title: USB Drive Caddy — Hex-Grill Open-Front Cubby
items.summary: N×M open-front cubby for low-profile USB-C 'disc' drives. Drives lay flat and slide in from the front; ~4 mm sticks out for pinch removal. Decorative hex perforation on top + sides. Ships pre-rotated — open face prints UP, back wall on the bed, zero supports.

items.title: Wizard Tower Pen Holder — fantasy castle desk organizer
items.summary: A squat stone wizard's tower that holds your pens and pencils. Crenellated battlement crown, spiral arrow-slit windows and a flared buttressed base; the bored centre well swallows a fistful of pens so they jut out the top like spires. Prints upright, no supports, fully parametric.

items.title: Lace Dubrae — Custom Sneaker Lace Name Plates (parametric, 48 names + your own)
items.summary: Sneaker lace dubraes — the little name plate that rides on your shoelaces. The lace runs hidden through one big channel that exits both ends, so the top stays a clean, curved name plate (it bows lengthwise like the real metal ones). One shared BODY hosts every name: print the body once, then drop any text plate on top in a contrast filament. Ships the body plus 48 ready-made names AND the full parametric .scad so you can type any word and re-render. Prints dead flat, no supports.

items.title: Traveling Shoe Horns
items.summary: Three compact, packable shoe horns in one set — a thin bent-sheet spoon, a print-in-place folding one, and a rotating/pivoting one. All slim enough to drop in a bag, suitcase, or coat pocket. Print them solid and strong, and treat them with a little care.

items.title: Cap Magnet Hook
items.summary: A little magnetic hook shaped like a baseball cap — the curved brim is the hook. Two Ø10x5 mm neodymium discs sit sealed inside the flat back and stick it to any steel surface (fridge, locker, radiator, steel door frame). No screws, no supports. A screw-mount version is included too. Holds LIGHT things only.

items.title: Bag Hook for a Desk Edge or a Chair Back
items.summary: Clamps onto a table edge, a desk lip or a chair backrest and gets the backpack off the floor. One part, no supports, no screws, no glue. Three sizes included — 20, 25 and 30 mm jaws — and a sprung tongue inside each takes up the slack below that, so between them they cover roughly 10 to 30 mm. A 7-minute fit-test coupon is included for every size so you can check the grip on your own table before printing the whole thing. The source file is included and fully parametric: change one number and you get a jaw for any thickness.

items.title: Lazy-Tongs Snapping Dragon — extending scissor grabber
items.summary: A lazy-tongs scissor reacher themed as a dragon: squeeze the tail and the neck telescopes out while the head snaps shut — one motion, one moving mechanism.

items.title: Norse Drinking Horn Shot Glasses — 4 Horns + Runed Flight Tray
items.summary: Four Norse drinking-horn shot glasses, 40 ml each, plus a runed flight tray. Display piece: the tray tips if moved.

items.title: Kiwi Bird Tea Bag Holder — feathered, beak holds the string, no supports
items.summary: A sitting kiwi whose back is a bowl for the used tea bag; the long beak probes the table so you wrap the string round it and the tag stays dry. Shaggy feather relief on the body. One part, 46 x 79 x 27 mm, prints belly-down with no supports.

items.title: Lemon / Citrus Hand Squeezer — Reamer + Strainer Cap + Pour Spout
items.summary: Two-piece manual citrus juicer: a strainer cap with a swirly helical reamer cone sits on a 95 mm bowl with an integrated U-trough pour spout. Twist a lemon-half over the cone, juice runs through the strainer holes into the bowl, lift the cap off and pour. Prints in two parts, no supports, no bridges.

items.title: Wave-Crest Napkin Ring — sculpted, no supports
items.summary: A napkin ring whose top rim rises and falls in three slow waves, with the wall swelling thickest directly under each crest so the band resolves into three lobes with a waist between them. The bore stays a true cylinder, so a rolled cloth napkin always passes. Every curved surface faces up or outward and the bottom rim is flat on the bed, which means zero overhang by construction: it prints standing, exactly as modelled, with no supports and no brim.

items.title: Napkin Tray — Toblerone-Style Holder w/ Diamond Cross-Hatch
items.summary: Upright napkin holder shaped like a Toblerone bar: flat rounded base + two isosceles-triangular side walls leaning in at the peak. Folded paper napkins (~8×16 cm) stack between the walls. Diamond cross-hatch engraved on every visible face — top of the base + both outer faces of each wall. Prints flat on bed, single piece, no supports.

items.title: Sink-Rim Sponge Tray — Hooks Over the Rim, Drains Into the Basin
items.summary: Single-bay sponge tray that hooks over a kitchen sink rim and hangs inside the basin. Sized to a standard kitchen sponge (~95×60×25 mm) with ~5 mm slack on every side. Floor drain slots + lower-wall drains let water run straight back into the sink — sponge dries instead of sitting in a puddle. Prints in one piece, open-top up, no supports.

items.title: Utensil Rest — spoon / ladle / spatula rest with a deep drip bowl, anti-soak ribs and a raised handle saddle
items.summary: A hob-side spoon rest that keeps the handle off the counter. The spoon head sits in a 8.5 mm-deep elliptical drip bowl, radial ribs hold it up out of its own drips, and a 30 mm saddle at the end cradles the handle in a U-groove. One piece, 132 x 88 x 30 mm, prints flat with no supports. Fully parametric OpenSCAD source included.

items.title: Beach Ring-Toss Lawn Game — Scoring Target Board + Tossing Rings (sand-resting, no stakes)
items.summary: A beach/garden ring-toss set: a flat sand-resting target board studded with 9 scoring pins (centre = 3 pts, 3 inner = 2 pts, 5 outer = 1 pt) plus chunky two-team tossing rings. Toss a ring underhand so it drops over a pin to score. Print two boards and set them a few metres apart. Fully parametric OpenSCAD — every diameter, height and ring size is a variable. Prints flat with no supports.

items.title: Beach Sandcastle Kit — 8-Piece Mould & Tool Set (castle buckets + sieve, rake, shovel, tamper)
items.summary: A complete kids' beach sandcastle kit: 3 stacking castle bucket-moulds (keep, tower, great hall) plus 5 sand tools — a perforated sieve-scoop, a rake, a shovel, a tamper and a detailing tool. Pack the wet sand into a mould, lift, and decorate with the tools. All parametric OpenSCAD, prints flat with no supports.

items.title: Floating Memory Tiles — Pool & Beach Sea-Creature Match Game
items.summary: A 24-tile memory/pairs match game (12 sea designs x 2) that FLOATS — play it on the beach blanket or straight in the pool. Each chunky 40 mm tile has a sealed internal air cavity, so it floats at any infill setting, and the face skin is deliberately heavier than the back: drop a tile in water and it rights itself ICON-DOWN, hiding its picture. Pool memory plays itself honest. Two-colour ready: one STL with named solids, split in your slicer and assign a contrast filament to the icon inlays. No supports, no AI — pure parametric OpenSCAD.

items.title: Beach Tic-Tac-Toe in a Scallop-Shell Box — Sea-Creature Peg Game (starfish vs shells)
items.summary: A pocket 3x3 peg tic-tac-toe for the beach that lives inside an openable scallop-shell clamshell box. The lid is the play board (pieces plug into its 9 holes, friction fit, so wind can't blow them off); the base is a plain storage cup, so the loose pieces can't spill. 5 starfish vs 5 scallop shells (equal counts, so whoever starts both players have a full set). Fully parametric OpenSCAD; every part prints flat with no supports.

items.title: Squeeze Breeze — Trigger-Spun Fan Toy (no batteries, mechanical novelty)
items.summary: A no-batteries mechanical novelty: squeeze the finger trigger and a multi-blade propeller on a flywheel spins up through a one-way ratchet, then coasts between squeezes. A satisfying hand-powered fidget that LOOKS like a hand fan. NOTE: it's a toy — the spinning blades move only a faint wisp of air, not a real cooling breeze. Multi-part, every part prints flat and supportless. Fully parametric OpenSCAD.
